# E-Commerce Product Grid Accessibility Design Plan > **For Claude:** Use a11y-planner protocol. Review with a11y-critic after implementation. > **Compliance target:** WCAG 2.2 AA > **Users who need accessibility:** Screen reader users (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver), keyboard-only users, low vision users > **Assistive technologies:** NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver, keyboard navigation, screen magnifier **Feature:** E-commerce product listing page with sort controls, collapsible filter panel, product grid, price range slider, add-to-cart interactions, and pagination. **Risk Level:** High (Multiple interactive patterns, dynamic state updates, third-party component constraints, cross-landmark live regions) **Component/Page Type:** Product Listing Page (PLP) --- ## Scope & Context This plan covers the accessibility design for an e-commerce product listing page featuring 24 products per page, sort controls, a collapsible filter panel with checkboxes and a dual-handle price range slider, product cards with ratings/pricing/availability states, add-to-cart interactions with toast feedback, cart badge updates, and pagination. The existing implementation uses `
`-based cards, Unicode star characters, visual-only strikethrough pricing, silent cart updates, and an un-ARIA'd custom slider. This plan replaces those patterns with WCAG 2.2 AA-compliant semantics, ARIA states, focus management, and state communication strategies before any code is written. ## Semantic Structure Plan The page must use landmark regions to communicate structure to assistive technology. Product cards are list items, not table rows or grid cells. Star ratings and sale pricing require specific markup patterns for screen reader compatibility. ### Structure Diagram ```html Skip to main content
...

Price Range

    Rating: 4 out of 5 stars ★★★★☆
    Was $149, now $89
    In Stock
Page 1 of 36 Next page
``` ## Interaction Pattern Design Every interactive widget maps to a WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices Guide (APG) pattern. Keyboard models and ARIA attributes are defined explicitly. ### Interactive Elements Table | Widget | APG Pattern | Keyboard Model | ARIA Attributes | WCAG Citation | |--------|-------------|----------------|-----------------|---------------| | Sort `` or checkbox). This is standard for in-page filters/sorts per APG. A polite live region announces "Results updated: X items found" without stealing focus. 3. **Focus Indicators:** Default browser outlines are sufficient (meet 3:1 contrast). If custom rings are used, apply `:focus-visible` only (not `:focus`) to avoid mouse-click artifacts. Use double-ring technique (`outline` + `box-shadow`) for visibility on all backgrounds. 4. **Composite Widgets:** Pagination uses standard `` elements; no roving tabindex needed unless links are wrapped in a custom container that removes them from the tab order (in which case, apply `tabindex="0"`). 5. **Hidden Content Strategy:** Filter panel uses `hidden` attribute + `aria-expanded`. When hidden, content is removed from accessibility tree and tab order. No `visibility:hidden` or `opacity:0` on interactive elements inside the collapsed panel. ## State Communication Design States are communicated visually AND programmatically. Color is never the sole indicator. ### State Communication Table | State | Visual Indicator | Programmatic Indicator | ARIA Attribute / Pattern | WCAG Citation | |-------|-----------------|----------------------|--------------------------|---------------| | Sort active | Dropdown shows selected option | Native ``, arrow keys navigate options, Enter selects. Screen reader announces "Sort by: Price: Low to High, list box". - [ ] **Filter Toggle:** Press Enter on toggle button. Panel expands/collapses. `aria-expanded` toggles correctly. Focus stays on button. - [ ] **Price Slider Keyboard:** Tab to min slider. Arrow keys adjust value. Screen reader announces "Minimum price: $30, slider". Page Up/Down adjusts by larger increments. Home/End goes to min/max. - [ ] **Add to Cart Action:** Focus button, press Enter. Button text changes to "Added ✓". `#cart-status` live region updates with confirmation message. Screen reader announces message politely. - [ ] **Cart Badge Update:** After add-to-cart, cart button `aria-label` updates to "Cart, 4 items". No chatty live region per increment. - [ ] **Star Rating SR:** Focus product card. Screen reader announces "Rating: 4 out of 5 stars" (not individual star characters). - [ ] **Sale Price SR:** Focus price area. Screen reader announces "Was $149, now $89" (not "deleted"). - [ ] **Availability Status:** Focus badge. Screen reader announces text ("In Stock"). Color is supplementary only. - [ ] **Pagination:** Focus current page link. Screen reader announces "Page 2 of 36, current". Next/Previous links work with Enter. - [ ] **200% Zoom:** Layout reflows without horizontal scroll. Touch targets remain ≥44×44px. - [ ] **Reduced Motion:** Button state change and toast appear instantly without animation when `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` is active. ## Implementation Tasks ### Task 1: Semantic Structure & Landmarks 🔍 **Review checkpoint after this task** **Files:** - `components/Layout.tsx` (header, main, footer structure) - `components/ProductGrid.tsx` (list wrapper, card structure) - `components/Pagination.tsx` (nav landmark) **Structure Stub:** ```tsx
